# add_header in a location drops the headers set at server level.
server {
    add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN";

    location /app {
        # ruleid: header-redefinition
        add_header X-App "one";
    }

    location /api {
        # ruleid: header-redefinition
        add_header X-Api "two";
    }

    location /static {
        # ok: header-redefinition
        root /var/www;
    }
}
# ok: header-redefinition
listen 80;
